column2: an  individual  who,  being  a  member  of
the Institute of Chartered Accountants of
Sri  Lanka,  or  of  any  other  Institute
established by law, possesses a certificate
to  practice  as  an  Accountant  issued  by
a firm of Accountants, each of the resident
partners of which, being a member of the
Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri
Lanka or of any other Institute established
by law, possesses a certificate to practice
as an Accountant issued by such Institute.
